label: The snow line
text: The hourly model code flips tomorrow from 61 (rain) to 71 (slight snow) at 18:00, as the hourly temperature crosses 1.2 °C, and makes Sunday code 73 — moderate snow — with a −3.6 °C low; wttr.in has light sleet at tomorrow's midday (+3 °C, feels 0 °C) turning to heavy snow overnight at −1 °C (feels −6 °C) with 17–36 km/h wind and 2 km visibility.
flags: Tomorrow's wind and visibility are wttr.in's alone; this run's open-meteo request carried no hourly wind, so the blowing-snow picture has one provider behind it.
